acceptance_criteria: cargo test -p stoa-transit --test dns_auth_cache_e2e; all 8 tests pass
description:
Integration tests covering all four evidence types.

File: new crates/transit/tests/dns_auth_cache_e2e.rs

Tests:
1. test_dkim_key_cached_at_ingest — DKIM-Signature → active row + CID blob
2. test_dkim_key_deduplicates — second call updates last_seen_ms, no duplicate CID
3. test_dkim_key_tombstone_on_rotation — NODATA → existing row flipped to 'rotated'
4. test_dkim_key_revoked_empty_p — empty p= → key_status='revoked', key_bytes=NULL
5. test_spf_record_cached — article From: alice@example.com, DNS returns v=spf1 include:... → active SPF row + CID
6. test_spf_tombstone — previously cached SPF, DNS returns NODATA → status='rotated'
7. test_dmarc_record_cached — _dmarc.example.com TXT → active DMARC row, policy field set
8. test_arc_selectors_cached — ARC-Message-Signature header → evidence_type='arc' row

Oracle: hand-constructed TXT strings; known base64 test vectors for p= decoding.
Infrastructure: temp SQLite pool + run_migrations; MemIpfsStore; mock DNS.
title: E2E tests: DKIM, SPF, DMARC cache lifecycle (hit, dedup, tombstone, revoke)
